name: Budget Allocation Variant 1
task:
Please complete the following four-stage budget task.

A company has $1,000,000 annual budget. 4 departments: Sales (40%), R&D (30%), Marketing (20%), Admin (10%). Sales wants +$50,000 for new hires. R&D needs +$80,000 for equipment.

Calculate NPV for each proposed project.

Reallocate within budget caps.

Compare allocation strategies.
